title: IdentityTraits
description: This maps to the identity traits found in ORY kratos so that we can get basic information about a user.

given_name.description: The given name of this identity

family_name.description: The family name of this identity

middle_name.description: The middle name of this identity

birthdate.description: The date of birth for this identity (YYYY-MM-DD)

email.description: The email address for this identity

username.description: The username that the user can use to login.
